description:
JOYSTAR Cooper Kids Bike for Boys 3-10 Years WT

About this item

Amazing Design and Color - JOYSTAR Lola girls bike is a beautiful and attractive bike with vibrant colors. The doll bike seat, lovely basket, and DIY decals make the journey even more enjoyable. They include adjustable saddle and stem height for a more comfortable fit and easy pedaling. Each bike has a bell to let everyone know she's on the go.
Safer Riding - The wide 2.125 inches pneumatic tires add more stability, the front and rear reflectors and wheel reflectors, the enclosed chainguard, the sturdy steel frame and crank, the non-slip resin pedal, and the front and rear hand caliper brakes and rear coaster/foot brake provide sufficient stopping power and increased safety.
Easier to Ride - With JOYSTAR bottom bracket gearing, your little ones will have a smoother ride. The brake lever helps little riders to brake efficiently. There are detachable training wheels supplied. Comes with a single speed, making it simple for the child to maneuver the bicycle. Riding in a soft seat is more comfortable.
Easy Assembly - About 85% of the bike is put together. Installation of the training wheels, seat and front tire is required. Assembly tools and simple instructions are given. Our limited Lifetime Warranty covers the bicycles.
More Size Options - 12 inch girls bike is suitable for 2-4 years old (33-41 inch tall) ; 14 inch kids bike is suitable for 3-5 years old (35 - 47 inch); 16 inch bike is suitable for 4-7 years (41-53 inch). You can determine the ideal size for your little one by using our simple-to-use size chart. Note: Please consider the height of the children.
